note: Plan 89-07 gave the macOS and Windows cells a disposable PostgreSQL, so the 386 pg-no-disposable-database entries plan 89-09 migrated into this shard excuse nothing on any cell and are removed. What this shard holds now is this plan own additions: one entry per test for the DEVELOPER machine, which has no disposable database (platform all, context local, owner Phase 100). The gate refuses a context local entry when CI is set, so none of them can ever excuse a CI cell.
added: the RET-02 relevance floor and every per-query rank_at_most were measured on the ParadeDB BM25 lexical leg; this cell's leg is plain-PostgreSQL full-text, which ranks differently by design (measured on the macOS cell, run 43357540296: query 'psycopg connection pooling exhaustion' returned none of its expected ids in the top 5). A floor for the plain leg is an unmeasured RETRIEVAL decision, not a CI one.
Phase 100 (quality gates own the CI engine matrix: real ParadeDB where a build exists, and a written capability statement where none does)

either the cell gets a real pg_search — plan 89-12 installs the pinned, checksum-verified ParadeDB pg_search@17 .pkg on the macOS runner, which makes the darwin half of this class STALE and 89-12 deletes it — or the ledger carries a written capability statement instead of a skip.
